summary: --sort velocity ranks by a recency-weighted mean of citations in the last up to 3 complete calendar years after publication (0.5/0.3/0.2, renormalised, missing year = 0), in the store before LIMIT. Local-only. A per-work counts_synced_at marker is set whenever the OpenAlex response carries counts_by_year (even []); velocity is null (no-data) while it is NULL or older than the current UTC year (so a partial year is never scored as complete), never zero. Errors with a refresh hint when no match is synced, else prints one stderr notice.
reason: A lifetime average favours old classics; a recent window ranks what is still being cited. OpenAlex omits zero years, so only the marker tells no-data from a true zero. Regen must keep complete years only and acceleration display-only.
validated_outcome: Live backtest (4-year-ahead): Spearman 0.794-0.818 per-year vs 0.813-0.822 here. Tests cover formula, marker, notice, real fixture.
